{{Quote|I am Ceetoo Deefour, former translator to Her Imminence, Queen Lina of Onderon; and this is my current master, the renowned illicit-transport specialist Jakarro.|C2-D4|<ref name="Depths" />}}
'''C2-D4''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that originally belonged to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Lina (Onderon)|Lina]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] before he came into the ownership of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jakarro]], who removed the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] limbs and carried his head strung around his neck as a translator. One of the few protocol droids in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to bear a criminal record, C2-D4 exhibited an uncommon capacity for deception and murder even before he became Jakarro's partner, and used his language skills to manipulate events towards profitable outcomes. He was eventually assigned to assist the short-tempered Jakarro on the Wookiee's visit to the [[royal court of Onderon]], and the court allowed Jakarro to take C2-D4 with him when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] left.
